earthandsky.name: Earth and Sky
earthandsky.description: Spend [FP] to activate both effects from the basic power simultaneously. If an upgrade from this ability would apply to one of the effects, it applies to both instead. The user may not activate this multiple times.

farnexus.name: Far Nexus
farnexus.description: Spend [FP][FP] to choose a character within medium  range of the user to become the originator of the effect, as if they were the user. The chosen character must both be touching the same uninterrupted patch of ground, but upgrades may be activated normally. The user may not activate this multiple times.

rangealterre.name: Range
rangealterre.description: Spend [FP][FP] to increase the range of the affected area to medium range. The user may not activate this multiple times.

rangeimpalterre.name: Range (Improved)
rangeimpalterre.description: When activating the Range upgrade, the Force User may instead extend the range of the effect to long range.

strengthalterre.name: Strength
strengthalterre.description: Spend [FP] to exclude characters equal to current Force Rating. The user may activate this multiple times.

strengthimpalter.name: Strength (Improved)
strengthimpalter.description: When activating the Strength upgrade, instead exclude a number of characters equal to twice the character’s Force Rating from the effects of the power.

trailingnexusre.name: Trailing Nexus
trailingnexusre.description: The power gains the ongoing effect: Commit [FO] after successfully activating the basic power to have the effect follow the Force User or other originator of the effect while they are in an appropriate environment.

battledurationre.name: Duration
battledurationre.description: Commit [FO][FO][FO] to sustain the effects of the power on affected targets while they remain in range.

battlererange.name: Range
battlererange.description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by 1 range band, to maximum of extreme range. This may be activated multiple times.

calltoactionre.name: Rally / Rout
calltoactionre.description:
Once per encounter when using Battle Meditation, the user may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Leadership check as part of the pool:

Unify: On success and power activation, each affected ally recovers strain equal to Presence, minus 1 per [DA] the user spends to generate [FP]. Spend [TR] to increase the user’s allied Force Strength by one during the next Mass Combat check made before the end of the encounter.

Isolate: On success and power activation, all affected minions groups remove half their members, rounding the remainder up. Spend [TR] to decrease  the adversary’s Force Rating by one during the next Mass Combat check made before the end of the encounter.

communiondissension.name: Communion / Dissension
communiondissension.description:
Unify: Affected allies may mentally communicate normally with one another for the duration of the power, and may offer assistance to one another regardless of distance.

Isolate: Affected foes may not receive [BO] granted by [AD] spends, nor may they offer or receive assistance.

durationimpbattle.name: Duration (Improved)
durationimpbattle.description: Commit [FO][FO] to sustain the effects of the power on affected targets while they remain in range instead of [FO][FO][FO].

masscombatbattle.name: Mass Combat
masscombatbattle.description: The user may add [FO] no greater than Force rating to Mass Combat checks. Spend [FP][FP][FP] to add [SU] to the results. This may be activated multiple times.

masterybattlere.name: Mastery
masterybattlere.description:
Unify: Once per session while this power is active, when an affected ally makes a Force Power check or a combined Force check, the user and any number of affected allies may suffer 2 strain and commit [FO]. For each that does, the ally adds an additional [FO] to the check. Afterwards, the Battle Meditation power ends.

Isolate: Once per session while the power is active, when an affected foe makes a check, the user may add [DE] to that check. Afterwards, the Battle Meditation power ends.

rangeimpbattlere.name: Range (Improved)
rangeimpbattlere.description: Spend [FP][FP] to change the range of the power and range upgrade to planetary scale. The user suffers 3 stran at the beginning of each of their turns while Battle Meditation is active using this upgrade.

strengthbattlere.name: Strength
strengthbattlere.description:
Unify: Spend [FP] to add [SU] instead of [AD]. This may not be activated multiple times.

Isolate: Spend [FP] to add [FA] instead of [TH]. This may not be activated multiple times.

strengthimpbattle.name: Strength (Improved)
strengthimpbattle.description:
Unify: Spend [FP][FP] to add an additional [SU].

Isolate: Spend [FP][FP] to add an additional [FA].

boundaggro.name: Bound Aggression
boundaggro.description: Once per encounter after a foe makes a successful attack but before it deals damage, the user may suffer 3 strain to use Bind on the attacker as an out-of-turn incidental. Spend additional [FP] to add that many [FA] to the result of the check.

confoundbind.name: Confounding Bindings
confoundbind.description: The user may spend [FP] to add [SE][SE] to checks made by all affected foes for the duration of this power.

forcetractor.name: Force Tractor
forcetractor.description:
After successfully activating the basic power targeting a starship or vehicle, treat it as if it were affected by the Tractor quality for the duration of the power, except that checks to escape the tractor are opposed by the user's Discipline. If [DA] was used to generate [FP], the target suffers 1 system strain per [FP] generated on the check.

Additionally, after immobilizing a ship or character, the user may spend [FP] to move the affected targets one range band, and may choose a different direction for each target.

magnitudeimpre.name: Magnitude (Improved)
magnitudeimpre.description: When the user activates the Magnitude upgrade, they instead affect additional targets equal to half the user's Willpower, rounded up.

masterybindre.name: Mastery
masterybindre.description: When using Bind, if otherwise unopposed, may make an Opposed Discipline vs. Resilience check as a part of the pool against a target. On success, if no [DA] were used to generate [FP], immediately stagger that target until the end of their next turn. If any [DA] were used to generate [FP] and the check succeeds, the target also suffers a Critical Injury, adding +10 per [FP] spent on the check.

powerfulstasisre.name: Powerful Stasis
powerfulstasisre.description: When using the Bind Power, the user may make a Discipline check as part of the pool. On success and power activation, they may immobilize a powerful and/or complex object, such as a waterfall or a spinning mechanism. The difficulty of the check is determined by the size and power of the target.

rangebindre.name: Range
rangebindre.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase power's maximum range bands by one, to maximum of Extreme. This may be activated multiple times.

rangeimpbindre.name: Range (Improved)
rangeimpbindre.description: When the user activates the Range upgrade, they increase the maximum range band of the power by two instead of 1.

strengthbindre.name: Strength
strengthbindre.description: Spend [FP] to increase the maximum silhouette of targets by 1, to a maximum of 4. This may be activated multiple times.

commune.name: Commune
commune.description: The user can reach out with their feelings to connect with the animals and plants that surround them.

commandcreature.name: Command Creature
commandcreature.description: Make an opposed Survival vs. Discipline check targeting a silhouette 0 creature within range as a part of the Commune power check. On success, may change the creature’s disposition towards the user one step, either from hostile to neutral or from neutral to friendly, and may spend [TR] to change the creature’s disposition from hostile to friendly. If the creature becomes friendly this way, the user may give them a simple command they will immediately abide to the best of their ability, performing a maneuver and taking an action.

communebp.name: Commune Basic Power
communebp.description:
The user can reach out with their feelings to connect with the animals and plants that surround them.

With Creatures: The user may spend [FP] to learn the emotional state and disposition of one non-sentient creature within short range. Disposition ranges from friendly, to neutral, to hostile. Emotional state runs the gamut of possible sentient experience, in a simpler form.

With Nature: The user may spend [FP] to gain sensory information or general insight from nature within short range. The GM delivers a brief sense or single feeling that the natural world wishes to impart.

communedura.name: Duration
communedura.description:
After successfully activating the Basic power, the user may commit [FO][FO] to maintain their connection to nature, or a creature while it remains in range. While committing, they may gain new or update known information as an incidental once during each future turn. 

Additionally, if the user successfully activated the Command Creature upgrade, the user may issue a command by performing a maneuver, which they will abide by immediately by performing a maneuver and taking an action.

communemag.name: Magnitude
communemag.description:
With Creatures: The user may spend [FP][FP] to affect an additional creature within range when communing or commanding.

With Nature: The user may spend [FO] or to gain additional information when communing from nature, or ask an additional question.

communemagimp.name: Magnitude (Improved)
communemagimp.description:
With Creatures: Once per turn when activating Magnitude, the user may affect a number of additional creatures equal to the user’s Force rating instead.

With Nature: Once per turn when activating Magnitude, the user may gain additional senses or ask additional questions equal to the user’s Force rating instead.

communemastery.name: Mastery
communemastery.description: Once per session, the user may spend [FP][FP][FP] to have a creature with silhouette no greater than the user’s Force rating, or a minion group of creatures with a silhouette not greater than half the user's Force rating, rounded up, appear in the scene. If no [DA] was spent to generate [FP], the creature is friendly to the user. If [DA] was spent to generate [FP], the creature is neutral, and attacks a character of the GM’s choosing.

communerange.name: Range
communerange.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the maximum range of the power by one range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

communerangimp.name: Range (Improved)
communerangimp.description: When activating the Range upgrade, increase the maximum range of the power by 2 range bands instead of 1. Additionally, when communing with nature, the specificity and complexity of information gained increases with range, per GM discretion.

communestrength.name: Strength
communestrength.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the silhouette of creatures that can be commanded by 1. Additionally, the user may target a creature minion group with a silhouette one less than the maximum silhouette they could affect.

communestrengthimp.name: Strength (Improved)
communestrengthimp.description: Once per round when activating Strength, the user  may increase the maximum silhouette by the user’s Force rating instead. Additionally, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to a combined Survival Force power check.

enhancesurvival.name: Enhanced Survival
enhancesurvival.description: When making a Survival check, the user may roll an Commune combined power check as part of the dice pool, and may spend [FP] to gain [SU] or [AD] on the check, but only one of each symbol.

naturalattune.name: Natural Attunement
naturalattune.description: When activating the Basic power, the user may freely converse with an animal within range, or ask the natural world within range a single, simple question.

conjdurationre.name: Duration
conjdurationre.description: After successfully activating the Basic Power, the user may commit [FO] to sustain a single conjured weapon or tool while it remains in Short Range. The user may commit additional [FO] to sustain additional conjured items and tools this way.

conjmag.name: Magnitude
conjmag.description: Spend [FP][FP] to conjure an additional tool, weapon, or conjured creature. The user may choose different effects from activated upgrades for each object conjured. The user may activate this multiple times.

conjrangeimpre.name: Range (Improved)
conjrangeimpre.description: When the user activates the Range upgrade, increase the maximum range within which a user may sustain a construct by 2 range bands instead of 1.

conjrangere.name: Range
conjrangere.description: The user may spend [FP] to extend the range at which conjured objects may be maintained by the user by 1 range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

conjspeedre.name: Speed
conjspeedre.description: Once per encounter, the user may spend 3 strain to activate the basic power as an incidental to conjure a tool or weapon.

conjstrengthre.name: Strength
conjstrengthre.description: The user may spend [FP][FP] to increase a conjured object's encumbrance by 1 and damage by 3 if it is a weapon, or increase its silhouette by 1 and damage by 5 if it is a conjured creature.

empimplement.name: Empowered Implement
empimplement.description: The user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to the first check made using the conjured item, or made by the conjured creature.

imbuimplement.name: Imbued Implement
imbuimplement.description: The user may spend [FP][FP] to increase another Force user's Force Rating by 1 while they wield an item conjured by the character.

mercycruelty.name: Mercy / Cruelty
mercycruelty.description: If no [DA] were spent, the user may increase the conjured weapon's (or conjured creature's attack) damage by 5 and have it gain the Stun Damage quality. If no [LI] were spent, reduce the weapon's (or conjured creature's attack's) critical rating by 1.

perfectedform.name: Perfected Form
perfectedform.description: Weapons, tools, and other objects the user conjures appear genuine and accurate to the form they represent. A perception check with a difficulty equal to the user's Force Rating is required to determine its falsity. Additionally, a wielder of the user’s conjured weapon may make attack checks using the Lightsaber skill, and may be used with the Reflect or Deflect talents.

attunementebb.name: Attunement
attunementebb.description:
Ebb: For the duration of this power, while there are fewer Light Side Points than Dark in the Destiny Pool, or they are equal, the user adds [DA] to all Force Power checks.

Flow: For the duration of the power, while there are fewer Dark Side Points than Light Side Points in the Destiny Pool, the user adds [LI] to all Force power checks.

durationebb.name: Duration
durationebb.description: The user may commit [FO][FO] after successfully activating the Basic Power to maintain the effects of Ebb/Flow while they remain committed, or until the end of the encounter.

ebbflowre.name: Ebb/Flow Basic Power
ebbflowre.description:
The Force user becomes a conduit for the Will of the Force, empowering allies and bringing misfortune to foes. Which power the user activates is determined by the Destiny Pool:

Ebb: If the Destiny Pool has more Dark Side than Light Side Points, or is evenly split, the user may spend [FP] to add [FA] to each check that has its difficulty upgrade by a player-spent Destiny Point until the end of the next round.

Flow: If the Destiny Pool has more Light Side Points than Dark Side Points, the user may spend [FP] to add [SU] to each check that has its ability upgraded by a player-spent Destiny Point until the end of the next round.

erodeebb.name: Erode/Expand
erodeebb.description:
Ebb: Foes within engaged range of the user add [SE] to checks they make for the duration of the power.

Flow: Allies within engaged range of the user add [BO] to checks they make for the duration of the power.

masteryebb.name: Mastery
masteryebb.description: Once per encounter, the user or an ally may spend an additional Destiny Point to upgrade the difficulty or ability of a single check. This applies the effects of Ebb/Flow twice.

onenessebb.name: Oneness of the Force
onenessebb.description: The first time the user successfully activates the Basic Power of Ebb/Flow each session, they add a Light Side Point to the Destiny Pool.

rangeebb.name: Range
rangeebb.description: Spend [FP] to increase the range at which characters add [BO] or [SE] to checks from the effects of Ebb/Flow by 1 range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

rangeimpebb.name: Range (Improved)
rangeimpebb.description: When activating Range, increase the maximum range of the power by 2 range bands instead of 1.

restorebal.name: Restore Balance
restorebal.description: Once per encounter, the user may spend [FP][FP] to change a Dark Side Point in the Destiny Pool to a Light Side Point, or vice versa.

speedebb.name: Speed
speedebb.description: Once per round, the user may perform the Ebb/Flow Power check as a maneuver. If they successfully activate the Basic power, they may not activate it again during this turn.

strengthebb.name: Strength
strengthebb.description:
Ebb: Spend [FP] to add [FA][TH] to checks whose difficulty has been upgraded by a player-spent Destiny Point instead of [FA].

Flow: The user may spend [FP] to add [SU][AD] to checks whose ability has been upgraded by a player-spent Destiny Point instead of [SU].

strengthimpebb.name: Strength (Improved)
strengthimpebb.description: Once per session, the user may spend [FP][FP][FP] to double the symbols added to the first check affected by Ebb/Flow. This does not double [SU] resulting from [TR] or [FA] resulting from [DE], but may double [TR] or [DE].

trueconduit.name: True Conduit
trueconduit.description:
Ebb: Once per encounter, if no [LI] were used to generate [FP], add [DE] to an affected check.

Flow: Once per encounter, if no [DA] were spent to generate [FP], add [TR] to an affected check.

wanewaxebb.name: Wane/Wax
wanewaxebb.description:
Ebb: Foes within engaged range of the user must first suffer 1 strain before taking an action while this power is active.

Flow: Allies within engaged range of the user may reduce the strain cost to perform additional maneuvers on their turn by 1, to a minimum of 1, while this power is active.

endureexhaust.name: Endure Exhaustion
endureexhaust.description: As an incidental, the user may commit [FO] to temporarily ignore the negative effects of exhaustion, hunger, or thirst. If at any point the user ceases committing [FO] to this upgrade, the negative effects immediately resume.

enduremagimpre.name: Magnitude (Improved)
enduremagimpre.description: The user may commit additional [FO] to temporarily ignore a number of Critical Injuries up to the user’s Brawn, rather than one additional Critical Injury. Endure must be separately activated for each Critical Injury.

enduremagre.name: Magnitude
enduremagre.description: The user may commit one additional [FO] to temporarily ignore the effects of one additional Critical Injury while the [FO] remains committed. Endure must be separately activated for each Critical Injury.

endurescars.name: Endure Scars
endurescars.description: As an incidental, the user may activate Endure to temporarily ignore the effects of a previously suffered Critical Injury.

endurestrimpre.name: Strength (Improved)
endurestrimpre.description: The user can use Endure to temporarily ignore the effects of Critical Injuries with a Severity of Hard ([DI][DI][DI]). Additionally, when activating Empowered Resilience, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to the check, and may do so multiple times.

endurestrre.name: Strength
endurestrre.description: The user can use Endure to temporarily ignore the effects of Critical Injuries with a Severity of Medium ([DI][DI]).

endurestrsupre.name: Strength (Supreme)
endurestrsupre.description: The user can use Endure to temporarily ignore the effects of Critical Injuries with a Severity of Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]).

overcomeelement.name: Overcome Elements
overcomeelement.description: As an incidental, the user may commit one or more [FO] to temporarily ignore hostile the effects of environments with rating less than twice the number of [FO] committed this way. Alternatively, the user may commit [FO][FO][FO] to ignore the effects of vacuum, atmospheric pressure, or drowning.

overcomeweakness.name: Overcome Weakness
overcomeweakness.description: Once per encounter while suffering a status effect, as a maneuver, make an Endure Power check. Spend [FP][FP] to end a status effect the character is suffering. Status effects may include but aren't limited to Immobilized, Restrained, Poisoned, Staggered, Burned, Disorient. The user may perform this maneuver even while immobilized or suffering another restrictive status condition.

brawlre.name: Enhanced Brawl
brawlre.description: Enhance can be used with the Brawl Skill.

combatmore.name: Combat Momentum
combatmore.description: Once per encounter, after using Force Leap to engage a foe, the next attack the user makes this round against that foe ignores that foe's melee defense.

empagilityre.name: Enhanced Agility
empagilityre.description: As a maneuver, commit [FO]. The user increases their Agility characteristics by 1 (to a maximum of 6).

empbrawre.name: Enhanced Brawn
empbrawre.description: As a maneuver, commit [FO]. The user increases their Brawn characteristics by 1 (to a maximum of 6).

enhancecoordre.name: Enhanced Coordination
enhancecoordre.description: Enhance can be used with the Coordination skill.

masteryenre.name: Mastery
masteryenre.description: Once per session when making a combined Enhance power check, the user may spend [FP][FP][FP] to immediately take another action.

pilotingenre.name: Enhanced Piloting
pilotingenre.description: Enhance can be used with the Piloting (Planetary) or Piloting (Space) skills.

rangeenre.name: Range
rangeenre.description: Spend [FP] to increase Force Leap's range by one range band, to a maximum of Medium.

speedenre.name: Speed
speedenre.description: The user may perform Force Leap as a maneuver instead of as an action.

speedimpenre.name: Speed (Improved)
speedimpenre.description: Once per encounter, immediately before or after a character acts, suffer 3 strain to perform Force Leap as an out of turn incidental.

strengthenre.name: Strength
strengthenre.description: Spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to a combined Enhance power check, separately and in addition to the Basic Power. The user may activate this multiple times.

effortlesssight.name: Effortless Sight
effortlesssight.description: The user may treat their vision as if the Basic power is always active. To gain the benefit of any other upgrade, the user must activate the power as normal. Effects that limit or disrupt the user's use of the force may affect this upgrade, per GM discretion.

farsightdurationre.name: Duration
farsightdurationre.description: The user may commit [FO] to sustain the effects of Farsight.

farsightmaster.name: Mastery
farsightmaster.description: The user may spend [FP][FP][FP]. When making a Force power check, the user may treat any space that Farsight allows them to see as the originating point of the power. Which power checks or combined power checks this can apply to is up to GM discretion.

farsightrangeimp.name: Range (Improved)
farsightrangeimp.description: When the user activates the Range upgrade, increase the maximum range of the power by two range bands instead of one. Additionally, increase the maximum range of Effortless Sight to extreme range.

farsightrangere.name: Range
farsightrangere.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the range of the basic power by 1 range band. Additionally, increase the maximum range of Effortless Sight to long range. The user may activate this multiple times.

farsightspeed.name: Speed
farsightspeed.description: Once per encounter, the user may perform the Farsight action as a maneuver. If the user does, they may not activate Farsight again this round.

farsightstrength.name: Strength
farsightstrength.description: When activating Empowered Sight, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to the check, and may do so multiple times.

piercingsight.name: Piercing Sight
piercingsight.description: The user may spend [FP] to see through one object within range as if it were transparent. Ignore the effects that cover, concealment, or defense this object would grant a target of a combat, Perception, or Vigilance check the character makes. The user may activate this multiple times.

sightsound.name: Sight & Sound
sightsound.description: Spend [FP] to choose a single source of sound within the range of Farsight. The user hears all sound that source creates as if it is at a conversational volume directed at them. The scope of a source could be an object, conversation, or individual, per GM discretion.

clarity.name: Clarity
clarity.description: The user may spend [FP] to pick out a specific detail from their vision. The user may activate this multiple times.

continuity.name: Continuity
continuity.description: Reduce the [FP] cost to activate the Basic Power by [FP], to a minimum of [FP].

foremagimpre.name: Magnitude (Improved)
foremagimpre.description: Once per Foresee power check when activating Magnitude, the user increases the number of engaged allies that are affected by the user’s Force rating instead of 1. Subsequent activations on the same check increase the number of affected allies by 1 as normal.

foremastery.name: Mastery
foremastery.description: Once per session before a check is made, may spend [FP][FP] and make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Cool or Vigilance check with a combined Foresee Force power check as an out of turn incidental. On success, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [TR] or [DE] to that check. The user must establish what previously unestablished portent they have foreseen that caused this result.

forerangeimp.name: Range (Improved)
forerangeimp.description: When activating the Range upgrade, the user may increase the maximum range by two range bands instead of 1.

foreseebpre.name: Foresee Basic Power
foreseebpre.description: The user may spend [FP] to gain vague hints of personal events to come in the following scene or encounter. Additional [FP] may be spent to increase the distance from the present moment the character may foresee, per GM discretion. For example, [FP][FP] may be spent to gain vague hints of the user’s coming day, whereas [FP][FP][FP][FP] may be spent to gain vague hints of the user’s coming week or fortnight.

forestrengthimpre.name: Strength (Improved)
forestrengthimpre.description: When the user activates Strength, they also [AD] to the check.

forestrre.name: Strength
forestrre.description: Once per check, if the user has gained specific details pertaining to the check they are making, they may suffer 2 strain to add [SU] to the result. How relevant the detail must be to the check it must be to qualify is per GM discretion.

formagre.name: Magnitude
formagre.description: The user may spend [FP] to affect an additional engaged ally (or themselves, if not the original target). The user may activate this multiple times.

forrangere.name: Range
forrangere.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the range at which they can affect their allies with the power by a single range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

healduration.name: Duration
healduration.description:
As a maneuver, the user may choose Heal or Harm, then commit one or more [FO] to this check: 

Heal: At the beginning of the user’s turn, engaged allies recover wounds equal to the number of [FO] committed to this effect. This does not count as a use of a Stimpack for the affected characters.

Harm: At the beginning of the user’s turn, engaged foes suffer wounds equal to the number of [FO] committed.

The user may not commit [FO] to both effects at the same time. When the user commits to Harm, they suffer 1 Conflict. Additionally, when an ally passively recovers wounds within 24 hours of being actively healed by the user’s Heal power, they recover additional wounds equal to the user’s Force Rating.

healmag.name: Magnitude
healmag.description: The user may spend [FP][FP] to affect 1 additional target within range. The user may activate this multiple times.

healmagimp.name: Magnitude (Improved)
healmagimp.description: Once per session when activating Magnitude, the user may instead spend [FP][FP][FP] to affect any number of characters within range.

healrange.name: Range
healrange.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase power’s range by 1 range band. Additionally, the user increases the maximum range of the Duration upgrade to short. The user may activate this multiple times.

healrangeimp.name: Range (Improved)
healrangeimp.description: When activating the Range upgrade, the user may increase the maximum range by two range bands instead of 1. Additionally, increase the maximum range of the Duration upgrade to medium.

healspeed.name: Speed
healspeed.description: Once per encounter, the user may suffer 3 strain to perform Heal or Harm as a maneuver. If the user does, they may not activate the power again this turn.

healstrength.name: Strength
healstrength.description: The user may spend [FP] to heal or inflict an additional number of wounds equal to the user's Force rating or ranks in Medicine, whichever is higher. This effect may not be activated multiple times. Additionally, when activating Empowered Medicine, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to the check, and may do so multiple times.

guidebereft.name: Guided / Bereft
guidebereft.description:
Imbue: Once per encounter, the user may spend [FP][FP]. One target of the power may suffer 3 strain to immediately take an action as an out of turn incidental. 

Exhaust: Once per encounter, the user may spend [FP][FP]. One target must first suffer 2 strain before taking an action for the duration of the power.

imbduration.name: Duration
imbduration.description: After activating the Basic power, the user can commit [FO][FO] to sustain the effects of this power on a target as long as the target remains in range. The user may do so multiple times to sustain the power for multiple targets.

imbdurationimp.name: Duration (Improved)
imbdurationimp.description: When the user activates Duration, they may commit [FO] per character to sustain the effects of Imbue instead of [FO][FO].

imbmagnitude.name: Magnitude
imbmagnitude.description: The user may spend [FP][FP] to increase or decrease a characteristic of another target within range by 1. This effect counts as their once per encounter effect for the Basic power. The user may activate this multiple times.

imbmastery.name: Mastery
imbmastery.description:
Imbue: Once per encounter, if no [DA] were used, one target increases each characteristic by 1 instead.

Exhaust: Once per encounter, if no [LI] were used, one target decreases each characteristic by 1 instead.

imbrange.name: Range
imbrange.description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by 1. The user may activate this multiple times.

imbrangeimp.name: Range (Improved)
imbrangeimp.description: When activating the Range upgrade, the user may increase the maximum range by two range bands instead of 1.

imbspeed.name: Speed
imbspeed.description:
Imbue: Once per encounter, the user may spend a Destiny Point to perform Imbue as a maneuver.

Exhaust: Once per encounter before a foe acts, the user may spend a Destiny Point to perform Exhaust as an incidental.

imbstrength.name: Strength
imbstrength.description: Spend [FP] to increase or decrease characteristic by 2 instead of by 1.

imbstrengthimp.name: Strength (Improved)
imbstrengthimp.description: If a characteristic would be raised above 6 or lowered below 1, the character adds [TR] or [DE] to their next check, respectively.

transference.name: Transference
transference.description: The user may spend [FP] to activate both Imbue and Exhaust as a single Power check, choosing different targets within range for each. The same characteristic must be chosen for each target, and the target(s) of Imbue and the user gain 1 conflict.

captiinfluncere.name: Empowered Charm
captiinfluncere.description: Influence can be used to make combined Charm power checks.

cloudedmindre.name: Clouded Mind
cloudedmindre.description: Spend [FP][FP] to add [FA] to each check made by each target for the duration of Mind Trick. This may be activated multiple times.

commandinre.name: Empowered Leadership
commandinre.description: Influence can be used to make combined Leadership checks.

durationinre.name: Duration
durationinre.description: The user may commit [FO][FO] after the successful activation of the power to maintain the effects of Mind Trick for as long as they remain committed, or until the end of the current encounter. If a target becomes out of range of the power, the effect persists until the end of their next turn.

entinre.name: Empowered Negotiation
entinre.description: Influence can be used to make combined Negotiations power checks.

infrangeimpre.name: Range (Improved)
infrangeimpre.description: When activating the Range upgrade, increase the maximum range by two range bands instead of one.

maginimpre.name: Magnitude (Improved)
maginimpre.description: When activating the Magnitude upgrade, spend [FP][FP][FP] instead to affect any number of characters within range. How this affects a large number of characters is up to GM discretion.

maginre.name: Magnitude
maginre.description: The user may spend [FP] to choose additional targets equal to the user's Force rating.

masteryinfre.name: Mastery
masteryinfre.description: Once per session, spend a number of [FP] depending on NPC type. If no [DA] were spent, the target of Mind Trick is completely pacified. If no [LI] were spent, they are sent into a violent rage or terrified stupor. The user may effect a minion group by spending [FP], a rival by spending [FP][FP], or a Nemesis whose current strain is greater than half of their strain threshold by spending [FP][FP][FP][FP]. How the character behaves in this state is GM discretion., but their role should meaningfully change their role, or be removed entirely, from the encounter.

menacinginfluence.name: Empowered Coercion
menacinginfluence.description: Influence can be used to make combined Coercion power checks.

rangeinfre.name: Range
rangeinfre.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the maximum range of the Influence power by one range band, to a maximum of extreme.

strengthinfre.name: Strength
strengthinfre.description: Spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to a combined Influence power check using a social skill, separately and in addition to the Basic Power. The user may activate this multiple times.

subdueuplift.name: Subdue / Uplift
subdueuplift.description: Spend [FP] to have the targets suffer or recover a number of strain equal to the user's Force rating.

buoybane.name: Buoy / Bane
buoybane.description:
Valor: Allies within short range upgrade the ability of checks made to resist fear a number of times equal to half the user's Force rating, rounded up.

Horrify: Foes within short range upgrade the difficulty of fear checks a number of times equal to half the user's Force rating, rounded up. This includes mundane fear checks and force checks instigated by sources other than the user.

solacesadism.name: Solace / Sadism
solacesadism.description:
Valor: If a target succeeds on a check assisted by this power, they recover 1 strain.

Horrify: If a target suffers strain from fear caused by this power, the user may recover that much strain and gain 1 conflict.

valorhorbp.name: Valor / Horrify Basic Power
valorhorbp.description:
The Force user can bolster their allies and harden their will against fear, or strike fear into the hearts of enemies:

Valor: Once per round as a maneuver, the user may spend [FP] to assist an ally within short range through the Force, assisting the ally until the user's never turn. This counts as unskilled assistance, but may be considered skilled assistance, per GM discretion.

Horrify: The user may spend [FP] to force a character within short range to immediately make an Average ([DI][DI]) fear check. The user gains 1 conflict.

valormagimp.name: Magnitude (Improved)
valormagimp.description: Once per session activating Magnitude, the user may instead spend [FP][FP][FP] to affect any number of characters within range. The user chooses the targets for both Valor and Horrify.

valormagnitude.name: Magnitude
valormagnitude.description: The user may spend [FP] to affect an additional character within range. The user may activate this multiple times.

valorrange.name: Range
valorrange.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the range of the Force power by 1 range band. Additionally, increase the range of Buoy / Bane and to medium. The user may activate this multiple times.

valorrangeimp.name: Range (Improved)
valorrangeimp.description: When the user activates Range, they increase the range of the Force power by 2 instead of 1. Additionally, increase the range of Buoy / Bane to long.

valorspeed.name: Speed
valorspeed.description: Once per encounter before a character acts, the user may spend a Destiny Point to make a Valor or Horrify check as an out-of-turn incidental.

valorstrength.name: Strength
valorstrength.description:
Valor: The user may spend [FP] to add [AB] instead of [BO] to check assisted by this power.

Horrify: Spend [FP] to increase the difficulty of fear check caused by this power once.

valorstrengthimp.name: Strength (Improved)
valorstrengthimp.description:
Valor: When activating Strength, add [AB][BO] instead.

Horrify: When activating Strength, instead increase the difficulty of the fear check twice.

Additionally, when activating Empowered Will, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to the check(s), and may do so multiple times.

disabledroid.name: Disable Droid
disabledroid.description:
When the user performs a combat check against an engaged droid or mechanical construct, they may make a Dismantle Force check as part of the pool.

Alternatively, as an action, the user may make an opposed Computers or Mechanics vs Discipline check targeting a droid, making a combined Dismantle force check as part of the pool. If successful and the droid is within range of the power, the user may spend [FP][FP] to stagger or immobilize it until the end of its next turn, and may spend [FP] to change its short term memory, per GM discretion.

manipulateremastery.name: Mastery
manipulateremastery.description: Once per encounter, when a droid or vessel suffers a Critical Injury or Critical Hit, the user may make a Manipulate Power check as an out of turn incidental. Spend one or more [FP] to increase or decrease the severity of the Critical Injury or Critical Hit by 10 per [FP] spent.

manipulatespeed.name: Speed
manipulatespeed.description: Once per encounter, the user may suffer 3 strain to perform Manipulate as a maneuver. If they do, they may not activate Manipulate again this turn.

manirangeimp.name: Range (Improved)
manirangeimp.description: When activating the Range upgrade, the user may increase the maximum range by two range bands instead of 1. Additionally, increase the maximum range of Reinforce Systems and Reinforce / Ruin by 2 range bands.

manirangere.name: Range
manirangere.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the range of the power by 1 range band. Additionally, increase the maximum range of System Reinforcement and Reinforce / Ruin by 1 range band.

manirangesup.name: Range (Supreme)
manirangesup.description: While the user is aboard a starship or vehicle, they may suffer 2 strain to treat the range of Manipulate as Planetary close when targeting enemy vessels. The range may not be increased past planetary medium.

manistrengthre.name: Strength
manistrengthre.description: Once per Power check, the user may spend [FP] to have the Basic power heal or inflict a number of strain equal to half the user's Intellect, rounded up, instead.

manistrimp.name: Strength (Improved)
manistrimp.description: When activating the Strength upgrade, the Basic power heals or inflicts a number of strain equal to the user's Intellect instead. Additionally, when activating Empowered Technopathy, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to the check, and may do so multiple times.

reconstruct.name: Reconstruct
reconstruct.description: As a maneuver, the user may commit [FO]. One damaged weapon or item counts as being unmanaged. The user may do this multiple times, choosing a different damaged item per [FO] committed.

reinruin.name: Reinforce / Ruin
reinruin.description: As a maneuver commit [FO] to increase or decrease an engaged droid’s soak by 2, or an engaged starship or vehicle’s armor by 1.

systemsrein.name: Systems Reinforcement
systemsrein.description: As a maneuver, the user may commit one or more [FO]. Increase either the hull trauma or system strain threshold of an engaged vessel by 3 per [FO] committed. The user may commit to either effects any number or times in any combination.

confoundaura.name: Confounding Aura
confoundaura.description: As a Maneuver, commit one or more [FO]. Add [TH] per [FO] committed to combat checks targeting the user, and to Perception, or Vigilance opposed by the user.

greaterill.name: Greater Illusion
greaterill.description: The user may send [FP][FP] to obscure or create a number of additional illusions equal to their Cunning plus their ranks of Deception.

mismagimp.name: Magnitude (Improved)
mismagimp.description: Once per session, the user may spend [FP][FP][FP] to affect any number of targets within range. If the check becomes opposed, the most difficult pool must oppose the user, per GM discretion.

mismagnitude.name: Magnitude
mismagnitude.description: Spend [FP] to affect additional targets equal to Cunning. The user may activate this multiple times.

mismasteryre.name: Mastery
mismasteryre.description: Once per session may make an opposed Deception vs. Vigilance check against a beguiled target to have a created illusion make an action targeting that foe, or to add a [TR] to a social check made by a character who is benefiting from Mask of Deceit targeting that foe. If this action is an attack, it deals damage as strain, with base damage of 5 plus 3 for each Silhouette larger than 1. It has a critical rating of null, and a range appropriate to the illusion. For each additional illusion the user has conjured, add +1 to the damage.

misrangeimp.name: Range (Improved)
misrangeimp.description: When activating the Range upgrade, the user may increase the maximum range by two range bands instead of 1.

misrangere.name: Range
misrangere.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase power's range by 1 range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

misspeed.name: Speed
misspeed.description: Once per session before a character makes a check, the user may spend a Destiny Point to use Misdirect as an out of turn incidental.

strengthimpmis.name: Strength (Improved)
strengthimpmis.description: The first time the user activates Strength per check, increase the maximum silhouette obscured or illusion created twice instead of once. Additionally, when activating Empowered Misdirection, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to the check, and may do so multiple times.

floatingbulwark.name: Floating Bulwark
floatingbulwark.description: After successfully activating the base power, the user may commit a number of [FO] up to the greatest silhouette among target objects to use objects of equal silhouette as cover, the user gains ranged defense equal to the silhouette. Per GM discretion, silhouette 3 or greater cover may make attacking the user or attacks from the user's position impossible, and may protect engaged characters. An additional character may be defended per each additional target object, as long as they stay within the maximum range of the power. The objects remain as long as [FO] remains committed.

magimpre.name: Magnitude (Improved)
magimpre.description: When activating the Magnitude upgrade, the user may spend additional [FP][FP] to increase the number of targets by half the user's Willpower, rounded up, instead of 1.

magnitudemovere.name: Magnitude
magnitudemovere.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase targets affected by 1. The user may activate this multiple times.

movemasteryre.name: Mastery
movemasteryre.description: The user may spend [FP] to use the Move power on non-willing living beings as if they were objects, including as objects to hurl at other foes, dealing damage to both. If only [LI] were used to generate [FP], the user may have any damage dealt by Move to be treated as strain damage. If only [DA] were used, all targets of Move attacks suffer a critical injury, adding +10 times the user's Willpower to the results.

push_propel.name: Push / Propel
push_propel.description:
The Force user can choose to either hurl objects to damage targets, or hurl blasts of Force directly at targets by making a ranged combat check using the Discipline skill combined with a Move power check, but must still spend enough [FP] to move the object or target:

Object: The difficulty of the attack is equal to the greatest silhouette among hurled objects. On success and power activation,  the attack does damage to the target based on the silhouette of the object + [SU]. Silhouette 0 deals base 5 damage, and each silhouette beyond deals 5 more damage than the last. Successful attacks using Silhouette 3 or greater deal damage to all characters within short range of the target, per GM discretion. The user may use multiple objects to hit one or more targets, they may do so as if the attack had the Auto-fire quality.

 Force: The difficulty of the attack is based on the range of the foe from the user. On success and activation, the target moves one range band away from the user and is knocked down. If the target collides with an immovable object of the same or larger silhouette, they take damage as if they were struck by an object of their own silhouette, using the damage calculation above.

rangeimmovere.name: Range (Improved)
rangeimmovere.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the power's range by 1 range band, to a maximum of Extreme. The user may activate this multiple times.

rangemovere.name: Range
rangemovere.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase power's range by 1 range band, to a maximum of Extreme. The user may activate this multiple times.

speedmovere.name: Speed
speedmovere.description: Once per encounter before or after a character acts, the user may suffer 3 strain to use the Move power as an out-of-turn incidental, may not make an attack. The user may target a foe within range with the basic power to interfere with an action. If that action was not an opposed check, it becomes opposed by the user's Discipline.

strengthimpmovere.name: Strength (Improved)
strengthimpmovere.description: The first time the user activates Strength each round, increase silhouette able to be targeted by 2 instead.

strengthmovere.name: Strength
strengthmovere.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase silhouette able to be targeted by 1, to a maximum of Silhouette 4.

strengthsupmovere.name: Strength (Supreme)
strengthsupmovere.description: Once per session when activating the Strength upgrade, the user may spend [FP][FP] instead to increase the silhouette able to be targeted by user’s Willpower, to a maximum of Silhouette 5 (this supersedes previous maximums).

bolsterburd.name: Bolster / Burden
bolsterburd.description:
Protect: Spend [AD] to have the target gain defense equal to [AD] spent. This may be activated multiple times.

Unleash: Spend [AD] to inflict 1 strain on a foe successfully hit by the attack. This may be activated multiple times.

deterdelay.name: Deter / Delay
deterdelay.description:
Protect: Spend [FP]. Foes must suffer 2 strain to engage affected targets for the duration of the power.

Unleash: Spend [FP] to give the attack Ensnare rating equal to the user's Force Rating.

durationpnunre.name: Duration
durationpnunre.description:
Protect: If no [DA] were spent to generate [FP], the power reduces damage of each attack hitting the target for the duration of the power. Protect expires on the target at the start of the target's next turn after they were succesfully attacked once.

Unleash: If no [LI] were spent to generate [FP], the attack gains Burn 2.

magimpprun.name: Magnitude (Improved)
magimpprun.description:
Protect: Protect reduces the damage of one attack per each affected target, instead of one attack total.

Unleash: Additional hits from the attack may be assigned to any foe within range, instead of those engaged with the original target.

magnitudeprun.name: Magnitude
magnitudeprun.description:
Protect: The user may spend [FP][FP] to affect 1 additional target within range. The user may still only reduce damage from one hit among all affected targets. This may be activated multiple times.

Unleash: The user may spend [FP][FP] to inflict an additional hit on a target engaged with the original target. These hits may deal the same damage as the initial hit. Each target may only be hit once. This may be activated multiple times.

magsupprun.name: Magnitude (Supreme)
magsupprun.description:
Protect: Once per session, spend [FP][FP][FP] to protect all allies within short range as if Magnitude has been activated for each of them. Magnitude may still be activated to affect additional targets beyond short range.

Unleash: Once per session, spend [FP][FP][FP] to give the attack a Blast rating equal to the user's Willpower. Each successful hit must trigger Blast separately.

rangeimpprun.name: Range (Improved)
rangeimpprun.description: When the user activates the Range upgrade, they increase the maximum range of the power by 2 range bands instead of 1.

rangeprun.name: Range
rangeprun.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the power's maximum range by one range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

strengthimprun.name: Strength (Improved)
strengthimprun.description:
Protect: Once per encounter when activating Strength, the user may instead spend [FP][FP] to reduce damage by twice Willpower plus [SU].

Unleash: Once per encounter when activating Strength, the user may instead spend [FP][FP] to set the attack's base damage equal to twice the user's Willpower plus their Force Rating.

strengthprun.name: Strength
strengthprun.description:
Protect: Spend [FP] to reduce damage from incoming attacks by a number equal to the user's Willpower plus [SU], instead of their Willpower.

Unleash: Spend [FP] to set the attack's base damage equal to the user's Willpower plus their Force Rating instead of their Willpower.

psychometry.name: Psychometry
psychometry.description: Reaching out with their feelings, Force users may sense events and people of the past.

beyondveil.name: Beyond the Veil
beyondveil.description: The user may make a Perception check combined with a Psychometry Force power check. On success, the user senses the last moments of an engaged corpse or remains. The user suffers 1 conflict. The difficulty of the check is determined by the GM, based on the age of the remains.

claritypsych.name: Clarity
claritypsych.description: Spend [FP] to increase the clarity of a sensed image, sound, or emotion. This may be activated multiple times, increasing the clarity of a different sensed experience each time.

detection.name: Detection
detection.description: The user may always determine if a sensed character is force-sensitive when using Psychometry. They also may sense if any character uses the Dark Side of the Force.

durationimppsych.name: Duration (Improved)
durationimppsych.description: Once per round while committing to Duration, the user may spend 2 strain to sense another image, sound, or emotion as an incidental, or increase the clarity of a previously sensed image, sound, or emotion.

magimppsych.name: Magnitude (Improved)
magimppsych.description: Once per check when the user activates the Magnitude upgrade, the user senses additional images, sounds, or emotions equal to the user's Force rating instead.

magpsych.name: Magnitude
magpsych.description: The user may spend [FO] to sense an additional experience from a character, object, or scene, and may do so multiple times.

psychbp.name: Psychometry Basic Power
psychbp.description:
Reaching out with their feelings, Force users may sense images, sounds, or emotions of people and events of the past. 

Special Rule ([LI]/[DA] use): When experiencing emotions, only [FP] generated from [DA] may be used to experience negative emotions such as rage or fear. Only [FP] generated from [LI] may be used to experience positive emotions such as selflessness or joy. Both can be used to experience other emotions such as confusion.

The user may spend [FP] to sense a distorted and brief image, sounds, or emotion from a previous event or person that happened in the immediate area or involved an engaged object. The event or person, and the age of the experience, is per GM discretion.

psychduration.name: Duration
psychduration.description: Commit [FO][FO] to maintain the effects of Psychometry.

psychmastery.name: Mastery
psychmastery.description: Once per session, the user may spend [FP][FP] to gain ranks in one skill possessed by a sensed character or the previous wielder of an engaged item until the end of the encounter. If the user possesses equal or higher skill ranks than the sensed character, increase their ranks in that skill by 1 instead. This chosen skill must be relevant to the event or person sensed, the object held, or the situation at hand, per GM discretion. Alternatively, the user may spend [FP][FP][FP] to temporarily gain access to a Force Power of the sensed character instead, including all non-Mastery upgrades sensed the character had, until the end of the encounter.

psychstrength.name: Strength
psychstrength.description: The user may spend [FP] to add [SU] to the next check they make that is relevant to their sensed experience. What is relevant is per GM discretion, but could be investigatory or interrogatory in nature.

strengthimppsych.name: Strength (Improved)
strengthimppsych.description: When activating Strength, the user also adds [AD] to the affected check.

trailmemory.name: Trail of Memories
trailmemory.description: The user may spend [FP] to learn the direction of a sensed character if they left the immediate area. This may be activated multiple times, choosing a different sensed character each time. The Duration upgrade cannot be used to increase the duration of this effect.

seekdurre.name: Duration
seekdurre.description: The user may commit [FO] after successfully activating the base power to continue tracking or remove [SE] imposed due to cover, concealment, defense, or illusory effects from attacks against a target even when it moves.

seekerssight.name: Seeker's Sight
seekerssight.description: As a maneuver, commit [FO]. Upgrade the ability of Vigilance and Perception checks once.

seekmagimpre.name: Magnitude (Improved)
seekmagimpre.description: When activating Magnitude, the user tracks or removes [SE] from additional targets equal to Force Rating instead.

seekmagre.name: Magnitude
seekmagre.description: Spend [FP] to track or remove [SE] from attacks targeting one additional target.

seekspeedre.name: Speed
seekspeedre.description: Once per encounter, the user may spend a Destiny Point to perform the Seek Power as a maneuver. If the user does, they may not activate the Seek power again this round.

seekstrengthre.name: Strength
seekstrengthre.description: The user may spend [FP] to gain additional details about the target’s location or direction, or remove additional [SE] from attacks the user makes against a personal-scale target equal to the user’s Force rating. The nature and type of details are per GM discretion, such as sensation, sounds, smells, or Force visions. Alternatively, the user may spend [FP][FP] to remove additional setbacks from attacks the user makes against a starship or vehicle target equal to the user’s Force rating instead.

seekstrimpre.name: Strength (Improved)
seekstrimpre.description: When activating Strength, additional details gained to track a character are of a type of the user’s choice rather than the GM’s. If more [SE] imposed by concealment, cover, defenses, or illusory sources would be removed from the user’s check to attack a target than there are [SE] on the check, add [BO] equal to the difference to the next attack the user makes against the target.

seektruth.name: Seek Truth
seektruth.description: The user may make an Average ([DI][DI]) Perception or Vigilance check (or opposed Perception or Vigilance vs Deception) to see through all sensory misdirections confronting them, whether from  technology or more esoteric means. This power dispels cloaking fields, holograms, Force Illusions, and even physical disguises, but does not reveal the truth of spoken or written lies. If the check is successful, the user may spend any number of [FP] to see through that many illusory effects.

seekunknown.name: Seek the Unknown
seekunknown.description: When activating the Basic power, may instead spend [FP] instead of [FP][FP] to gain insight into lost or unknown people’s location or direction.

empathysense.name: Empathy
empathysense.description: Spend [FP] to decrease  the difficulty of the next social check targeting a character whose emotions or thoughts the user has sensed this encounter.

magimprovedsensere.name: Magnitude (Improved)
magimprovedsensere.description: When activating the Magnitude upgrade, the user may instead spend [FP][FP][FP] to affect all characters within range of the power.

magsensere.name: Magnitude
magsensere.description: Spend [FP] to increase the number of targets affected by power equal to the user's current Force Rating. The user may activate this multiple times.

masterysensere.name: Mastery
masterysensere.description: Once per session, make a Sense power check combined with an opposed Discipline vs. Discipline check against a living target within range. If the check succeeds, spend [FP] to ask the GM a number of simple questions that the target's mind could answer equal to [FP] spent this way. If [FP] generated from [DA] were spent, the target suffers strain equal to total [FP] spent on the power.

protectiveinstincts.name: Protective Instincts
protectiveinstincts.description: When an ally engaged with the user becomes the target of an attack while committing [FO] to Threat Sense, the user may choose to upgrade the pool of the check as if they were being attacked. This counts against the number of times Threat Sense can trigger each round.

rangeimpsensere.name: Range (Improved)
rangeimpsensere.description: When activating the Range upgrade, increase the maximum range by 2 instead of 1.

rangesensere.name: Range
rangesensere.description: Spend [FP] to increase the power's range by one range band.

speedsensere.name: Speed
speedsensere.description: Once per encounter, when targeted by an attack, the user may commit [FO] to Threat Sense as an out of turn incidental. The attack still triggers Threat Sense, upgrading the pool.

surfacereading.name: Surface Reading
surfacereading.description: Spend [FP] to sense the current thoughts of one living target whom the user is engaged with. This effect does not benefit from the Magnitude upgrade. The user may activate this multiple times.

constraincorrupt.name: Constrain / Corrupt
constraincorrupt.description:
Whenever a foe targets a character affected by Suppress with a Force power, the power gains the following effect, based on the user’s alignment:


Light Side User: If that foe used [DA] to generate [FP] on the check, they suffer strain equal to the user’s ranks in Discipline.


Dark Side User: The Force user may suffer 2 strain to remove rolled [LI] up to the user’s Discipline and add that many [DA]. The user gains 2 Conflict.

devoid.name: Devoid
devoid.description: Once per encounter, whenever a foe fails a Force power check or generates no [FP], the user may suffer 3 strain to add [DE] to the check.

nullification.name: Nullification
nullification.description: Suppress now affects all Force power checks made by foes within range instead of only hostile Force power checks targeting the user or their allies within range.

stillness.name: Stillness
stillness.description: While the user has committed all of their [FO] they upgrade the ability of each check they make once. Force Power checks that commit [FO] as a result of the check after it is made do not benefit from this upgrade.

suprangeimpre.name: Range (Improved)
suprangeimpre.description: When the user activates the Range upgrade, increase the maximum range of the power by two range bands instead of one.

suprangere.name: Range
suprangere.description: Spend [FP] to increase the power’s range by one range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

supspeed.name: Speed
supspeed.description: Once per encounter, the user may suffer 3 strain to perform Suppress as a maneuver.

supspeedimp.name: Speed (Improved)
supspeedimp.description: Once per session before a foe makes a check, the user may spend 1 Destiny Point to perform Suppress at an out of turn incidental.

supstrengthre.name: Strength
supstrengthre.description: The user may spend [FP] to add additional automatic [FA] to hostile Force power checks.

totalsuppression.name: Total Suppression
totalsuppression.description: As a maneuver, commit one or more [FO]. When a foe targets the user with a Force power, after the foe generates [FP], the user may reduce the total [FP] generated by 1 per [FO] committed (to a minimum [FP] of 0).

backfoot.name: On The Back Foot
backfoot.description: Add [SE][SE] to all checks the target makes against the user until the end of the next round.

empoweredinit.name: Empowered Initiative
empoweredinit.description: When making a check to determine initiative, the user may make an Insight Power check as a part of the pool. Spend [FP] to add [SU] and/or [AD] to all checks the user makes during the first round of the encounter, but only one of each symbol.

insightduration.name: Duration
insightduration.description: Spend [FP] to extend the effects of Insight for an additional round. The user may activate this multiple times.

insightmagimp.name: Magnitude (Improved)
insightmagimp.description: Once per round when activating Magnitude, may spend  [FP][FP] to affect additional allies or foes equal to the user's Force rating instead.

insightmagnitude.name: Magnitude
insightmagnitude.description: The user may spend [FP] to affect an additional ally with Shared Initiative or character with the Basic power. The user may activate this multiple times.

insightmastery.name: Mastery
insightmastery.description: Once per session after successfully activating the Basic power, the user may spend [FP][FP][FP] to specify the next action one NPC target will take, adding the user’s choice of [SU] or [FA] to any check that character makes until the user’s next turn. Per GM discretion, action should be within the target’s normal characterization and not be obviously suicidal.

insightrange.name: Range
insightrange.description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the range of the Basic power and Shared Initiative by 1 range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

insightrangeimp.name: Range (Improved)
insightrangeimp.description: When the user activates the Range upgrade, increase the range by 2 range bands instead of 1.

insightspeed.name: Speed
insightspeed.description: Once per encounter, the user may suffer 3 strain to perform Insight as a maneuver. If they do, they may not activate Insight again this round.

insightstrength.name: Strength
insightstrength.description: Spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to each check affected by Empowered Initiative. Additionally, the user may spend [FP][FP] to increase the number of dice added by A Step Ahead and On The Back Foot by one, and may do so multiple times.

seizemoment.name: Seize the Moment
seizemoment.description: When performing an Insight power check as part of an initiative check, if no [DA] were spent, each ally adds [SU] to their initiative check. If [DA] was used, the user may take an action before the encounter begins, but each foe adds [SU] to their initiative check.

sharedinit.name: Shared Initiative
sharedinit.description: When using Insight while making an initiative check, an ally within range adds the same symbols to checks they make during the first round of the encounter.

stepahead.name: A Step Ahead
stepahead.description: The user adds [BO][BO] to all checks they make against the target until the end of the next round.
